title: Range Pair
summary: Catches backwards, empty or wildly oversized date and number ranges, and repairs them the likely way (next year for Dec → Jan).
description: From/to field pair that catches reversed ends (moving a 28 Dec → 3 Jan end into next year rather than just swapping), equal exclusive ends, and year or extra-zero typos that make a range huge, each with a one-tap fix.
catches: Reversed ends, with the likelier repair (next year for Dec → Jan)
Empty ranges when the end is exclusive
Oversized ranges from a year or extra-zero typo (maxSpan)
Plain swap as an alternative fix
limits: Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in UTC; times of day aren't handled
maxSpan has to be set for size checks to mean anything
a11y: Both ends have visible labels and are described by a polite status region
Fix and swap are buttons; icons are aria-hidden
Focus returns to the From field after a fix
